name: jwt-refresh-rotation-p1
prompt: how do I keep users logged in securely without forcing a re-login every hour

chunks.content: decided to issue a short-lived access token plus a longer refresh credential, and to swap the refresh credential for a fresh one on every use so a stolen one is single-use
the refresh credentials live server-side in a hashed table keyed by family id, so we can revoke a whole device lineage at once
the login form now blocks submission until the email field matches a valid pattern and the password is at least 12 characters
if a refresh credential is presented twice we treat the lineage as compromised and invalidate every token in that family, logging the user out everywhere
the password reset link expires one hour after it is emailed, forcing the user to request a new login link if they wait too long
added the frontend origin to the CORS allowlist so the SPA can call the API with credentials
bumped the connection pool to 40 after we saw checkout timeouts under load
profile avatars are resized to 256px and stored in object storage with a content hash filename
rewrote the welcome email template to use the new brand colors and a single CTA button
throttle login attempts to 5 per minute per IP to slow credential stuffing
request latency percentiles are now scraped by Prometheus at /metrics every 15 seconds
the new dashboard is gated behind a beta flag that defaults off for everyone
the readiness probe returns 200 only after the cache warmer has finished its first pass
